purpose: Directly test whether eligible capture-branch-expansion candidates are more likely to manifest under phase2 search than legacy search when evaluator, depth, seeds, and random openings are held fixed.

designSources: E-011 formal results and trajectory-ply sensitivity
E-017 formal not-confirmed result and structural counts
independence.designUseOnly: E-011 and E-017 are used only to motivate H16, choose the paired primary endpoint, and choose a conservative corpus size before E-018 data generation.

primaryUnit.name: paired shared-seed game
primaryUnit.pairingRequirement: P2 and LG must use the same seed and identical random-opening boundary state for each game index.
primaryUnit.binaryEndpointPerCondition: 1 if the game contains at least one category-A candidate in the primary population classified as capture-branch-expansion; otherwise 0.

primaryEndpoint.name: paired search-profile difference in capture-branch-expansion manifestation
primaryEndpoint.comparison: P2 versus LG on the paired game-level binary endpoint
primaryEndpoint.test: two-sided exact McNemar test on discordant pairs
primaryEndpoint.directionRequirement: P2-only discordant pairs must exceed LG-only discordant pairs
reportedEffectMeasures: discordant-pair odds ratio n10/n01 with infinity reported when n01=0

structuralSecondaryEndpoint.candidateComparison: Compare capture-branch-expansion rates among unique candidate trajectory-ply units between P2 and LG; report Fisher exact two-sided p-value, risk ratio, and risk difference.
structuralSecondaryEndpoint.withinConditionEnrichment: For each condition separately, report trajectory-ply-deduplicated candidate versus control expansion rates and risk ratio.
structuralSecondaryEndpoint.rationale: A zero or very low LG expansion count is a potentially H16-consistent observation and must not be converted into automatic insufficiency by requiring a minimum LG expansion count.

sampleSizeDesign.caveat: These projections are planning approximations from prior experiments, not inferential evidence or a formal McNemar power calculation. The primary confirmation rule depends on paired discordant games, not on achieving projected structural counts.

secondaryEndpoints: Unique candidate trajectory-ply count by search profile
Unique candidate trajectory count by search profile
Unique expansion trajectory-ply and trajectory counts by search profile
Candidate archetype and expansion archetype counts by search profile
Largest trajectory-ply duplicate multiplicity by search profile
Trajectory-ply-deduplicated candidate/control enrichment within each profile
Direct candidate-level P2 versus LG Fisher exact comparison

decisionRule.confirmed: Formal corpus integrity and pairing pass, at least 20 discordant paired games are available, the two-sided exact McNemar p-value is <= 0.05, and P2-only discordant pairs exceed LG-only discordant pairs.
decisionRule.notConfirmed: Formal corpus integrity and pairing pass and at least 20 discordant paired games are available, but the preregistered McNemar significance or direction criterion fails.
decisionRule.inconclusive: Corpus generation, schema/hash/source validation, paired-opening validation, seed pairing, candidate-event construction, required output construction, or minimum 20 discordant-pair availability fails.

executionPolicy.approvalRequirement: A separate explicit user instruction is required before generating the E-018 formal 4000-game corpus.

changePolicy: Any post-preregistration change to corpus size, seed range, conditions, candidate/regime thresholds, primary unit, McNemar test, alpha, direction rule, minimum discordant pairs, or decision contract requires a new preregistration version. E-018 results may not be used to relax this file after data generation starts.
